Its adjustable end cap with 5 pressure settings and automatic pulp ejection allow for customized juicing, ensuring up to 99% juice yield with smooth filtration thanks to double-layer fine mesh filters, a powerful motor, and an upgraded spiral auger. The 3.54-inch wide feed chute accommodates whole fruits and vegetables, reducing prep time, while the blade-free design and built-in safety lock system make it safe for families with teens and children. Compact yet powerful, this juicer includes a 1000ml pulp cup and 600ml juice cup, plus non-slip footpads and built-in cord storage for stability and tidy storage. Cleanup is simple with one-button disassembly and the included cleaning brush, making this masticating juicer a practical, durable, and space-saving solution for kitchens of all sizes. Perfect for health-conscious individuals, families, and juice lovers, the Cold Press Juicer with Touch Screen delivers nutrient-rich juice, frozen desserts, and everyday convenience—bringing fresh flavor and wellness straight to your home.
